copy.headline: Winter Wonderland Begins Tuesday
copy.caption: On Tue, Dec 1, watch the tallest live Christmas tree in Texas light up alongside a 6:15 pm holiday concert with Texas music legend Michael Martin Murphey at the 80th annual tree-lighting ceremony in Sundance Square. Leading the 6:55 pm Lighting Countdown will be Texas Gov-Elect Gina Hinojosa.
